title: Add Pollinations for Unity to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollinations for Unity](https://github.com/Marcus-Mok-GH/pollinations-unity) to build
- A dependency-free Unity Package Manager package that adds Pollinations text, image, and speech generation to Unity games. Async Task-based C# helpers cover chat completions, image generation (returns 

Fixes #15622, fixes #15580

gist.headline: A bee enters Unity
gist.blurb: Pollinations for Unity joins the app collection. It brings text, image, and speech generation into games without bringing a pile of dependencies along for the ride.
gist.summary: Added Marcus-Mok-GH’s dependency-free Pollinations for Unity package to the app collection, with async Task-based C# helpers for chat completions, image generation, and speech generation.
gist.impact: Unity developers get a package they can install through Unity Package Manager to add Pollinations-powered chat, images, and speech to games.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Pollinations for Unity as a cozy game-building desk: a Unity-style geometric cube beside a game screen, with a chat bubble, picture, and sound-wave icon representing the package’s three capabilities. Polli, wearing a tiny developer tool belt, helps assemble the scene among pixel flowers and code-plants.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art game workshop, Polli uses a tiny developer tool belt to arrange a chat bubble, a little landscape picture, and a sound-wave icon around a Unity-style cube on a glowing game screen, with code-plants growing beside the desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients, a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) glow against warm cream, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
